values.title: “Types that go from the database all the way to the component. That alone sold us.”
values.summary: 9 days · from idea to launch · $0 · first-year infra bill
values.body:
## The challenge

A single developer had to ship a complete product: database, auth, an API, and a typed client, while also building the product itself.

## Why Tessera

One schema produced the whole backend, and the generated types followed the data all the way to the components.

## Results

Fieldnote launched in nine days, now has 12,000 users, and has not paid an infrastructure bill in its first year.
